plain_statement: It is false that: KM0: AND/OR gates of two earlier wires, each AND with an lf or two pf inputs (lf/pf: reads no line/point). If 4 lemmas: I no 4-cycle, an edge; tau <= every vertex cover; C KM0, true on edges, false on <=k lines (k>=1), no edge. Live at p: a chain up from a cone gate (below output, reads both) has all AND lf inputs true at p. For pf inputs h of cone gates, L(h): lines making h true, A(h): points where a gate it feeds is live. a_w: #p in A(h) for h with L(h) = {w}; b_p: #w in L(h) for h with |L(h)| >= 2, A(h) = {p}. Sum a_w + sum min(k + 1, b_p) + tau <= #gates + 1.
